title: LabMiM Micrometeorology and Solar Radiation Intelligence
description:
Toolkit for solar irradiance and micrometeorology research at the LabMiM station, Universidade Federal da Bahia, Salvador, Brazil (13.0°S).

It post-processes WRF output into JSON and GeoJSON payloads for web mapping, builds a quality-controlled archive from the station's Campbell dataloggers, estimates diffuse horizontal irradiance from all-sky camera images with multimodal deep learning, and corrects the model's diffuse radiation bias with machine learning.

Held-out test performance for the image model: DHI RMSE 20.80 W/m², R² 0.939, skill over the clear-sky baseline +0.72.
